steps.text: Dash says there's a real Earth astronaut waving from the Mothership Pad, east of the Observatory path. Go and say hi!

checklist: Fly the mothership (step onto the pad and call it down)
Fly the mothership through the schematic floating high over town

reward.message: Up in the Mothership done! You can fly anywhere now. Zippy can build the Rocket Board. The Astronaut says Rex is waiting by the portal! (+12 sparkles)
